content_zh:
聂伊辰回过神来，一把抓住林柔的肩膀，急切问道。
听聂伊辰说让陈阳跑路，林柔心底咯噔一跳，知道陈阳和李恒江的事情，比自己想象的还严重得多。
她也来不及问怎么回事，拉着聂伊辰就朝楼下跑去：“陈阳在楼下。”
两人下楼来，却哪里还有陈阳的影子。
陈阳回到计算机学院后，他并没有去教室，因为在楼道口的时候，他被班主任杨雪薇拦了下来，叫到了办公室。
看着杨雪薇两条大长蹆，包裹在职业套装里的妩媚身姿，以及眼神中难掩的魅意，陈阳心底又是暗叹了一次狐媚之体厉害，就连他都有些蠢蠢欲动，血脉膨胀。
杨雪薇坐在办公桌后面，柔媚的脸上露出为难之色，开口道：“陈阳，刚才教务处主任给我打了个电话，说你在教材科外的胡同里打了人，是不是有这事？”
陈阳没想到美女老师找自己是为了这件事，回答道：“杨老师，那几个小混混要非礼林柔，所以我才动手的。”
听到这话，杨雪薇看向陈阳的目光中闪过赞赏之色，这位学生不仅不被自己的美丽所迷惑，而且还见义勇为，帮助学习委员，令杨雪薇刮目相看。
但随即杨雪薇就皱起了眉头，对陈阳道：“这件事你没做错，可是却惹了麻烦，那几个小混混是黑狼帮的人，他们的老大是黑狼帮江临区的大头目魏勇，势力非常庞大。教务处主任说魏勇直接把电话打给了校长，让学校把你交出去，不然以后学生们都别想安心上学。”
只是打几个小混混而已，对方竟然找上了校长，而且还如此肆无忌惮地威胁，陈阳这才发现，那黑狼帮还真有几分势力。
“这些坏人也太嚣张了，到底还有没有王法！”陈阳义愤填膺道，话锋一转，看向杨雪薇：“杨老师，校长怎么说？不会是真要把我交出去吧？”
杨雪薇从抽屉里拿出一个鼓鼓囊囊的信封，推到陈阳面前，难以启齿道：“校长好说歹说，这才让魏勇放过你，不过你得亲自去给魏勇和他的手下赔礼道歉，这是校长让人送来的五万块红包，你带给魏勇吧。”
见陈阳皱了下眉头，杨雪薇叹道：“陈阳，校长也是没办法，面对那些黑道的坏人，我们这些普通人根本没辙，否则便会招来更大的祸端。”
“校长还不算坏，至少给我准备了红包。”
陈阳心里笑道，抓起桌上的信封塞进怀里，一脸忧伤对杨雪薇道：“杨老师，真是世风日下，坏人当道，我们这种好人，只能被人欺负。虽然我心中怒火燃烧，但为了大局，我还是决定去找魏勇，保障我们东安工大学生的安全。”
“杨老师，黑狼帮在江临区的老巢是在什么地方，我现在就去找魏勇。”陈阳大义凛然道。
看着陈阳哀叹却又大义的样子，杨雪薇心里很不是滋味，作为老师，不正应该保护自己的学生们，可是现在，学生见义勇为，却还要去给别人赔礼道歉，这可真是窝囊。
“陈阳，我跟你一起去。”
杨雪薇从办公桌后站了起来，咬了下艳红的嘴唇，眼神坚定，一副奔赴战场的模样。

见此，陈阳心里对这个狐媚之体的女人的防备心降低了很多，虽然她天生对男人极具魅惑，但却心底善良，充满了正能量，是个好老师。
陈阳瞄了眼杨雪薇的身子，为难道：“杨老师，你长得这么漂亮，身材又这么火辣，那些都是坏人，万一他们对你怎么样，到时候可怎么办？”
杨雪薇见陈阳的目光看过来，俏脸一红，连忙紧了紧衣领，却并没有责怪陈阳，反而心里埋怨起自己太狐媚。这么多年，她对男人到底有多大的吸引力，她最清楚不过，陈阳直到现在才瞄了眼她的身子，已经是她见过定力最好的男人了。
一想陈阳的话的确有道理，加上自己超强的魅惑力，杨雪薇还真怕被人给非礼了，要知道那些人可是敢在学校非礼林柔，到了他们的地盘，肯定更加肆无忌惮。
不过杨雪薇只是犹豫了下，就做出决定，坚定道：“陈阳，你是我的学生，我必须保证你的安全，我一定要和你一起去。”
“杨老师，既然你执意要去，那我就算是拼着不要命，也会尽力保护你的。”
陈阳放松了对狐媚之体的杨雪薇的最后一丝戒备，心底暗笑一声，和杨雪薇走出了办公室。

Nie Yichen came back to his senses, grabbed Lin Rou's shoulders, and asked eagerly.
Hearing Nie Yichen tell Chen Yang to run away, Lin Rou's heart skipped a beat, knowing that the matter between Chen Yang and Li Hengjiang was much more serious than she imagined.
She didn't have time to ask what was going on, so she pulled Nie Yichen and ran downstairs: "Chen Yang is downstairs."
The two of them came downstairs, but Chen Yang was nowhere to be seen.
After Chen Yang returned to the School of Computer Science, he did not go to the classroom because at the entrance of the corridor, he was stopped by his head teacher Yang Xuewei and called to the office.
Seeing Yang Xuewei's long crotch, her charming figure wrapped in a professional suit, and the unconcealed charm in her eyes, Chen Yang secretly sighed again in his heart that the foxy body was so powerful that even he was a little ready to move, and his blood veins were swelling.
Yang Xuewei sat behind the desk, with a look of embarrassment on her soft face, and said, "Chen Yang, the director of the Academic Affairs Office just called me and said that you beat someone in the alley outside the Teaching Materials Department. Is this the case?"
Chen Yang didn't expect that the beautiful teacher was looking for him for this matter, so he replied: "Teacher Yang, those gangsters wanted to molest Lin Rou, so I did it."
Hearing this, Yang Xuewei looked at Chen Yang with admiration in her eyes. Not only was this student not deceived by her own beauty, but he also acted bravely and helped the study committee members, which impressed Yang Xuewei.
But then Yang Xuewei frowned and said to Chen Yang: "You did nothing wrong in this matter, but you caused trouble. Those gangsters are from the Black Wolf Gang, and their boss is Wei Yong, the leader of the Black Wolf Gang's Jianglin District. He is very powerful. The director of the Academic Affairs Office said that Wei Yong directly called the principal and asked the school to hand you over, otherwise the students will not be able to go to school with peace of mind."
He was just beating up a few gangsters, but they actually approached the principal and threatened him so unscrupulously. Only then did Chen Yang realize that the Black Wolf Gang was really quite powerful.
"These bad guys are too arrogant. Do they still have the law?" Chen Yang said angrily. He changed the subject and looked at Yang Xuewei: "Teacher Yang, what did the principal say? Are you really going to hand me over?"
Yang Xuewei took out a bulging envelope from the drawer, pushed it in front of Chen Yang, and said unspeakably: "The principal persuaded Wei Yong to let you go, but you have to go and apologize to Wei Yong and his men in person. This is a red envelope of 50,000 yuan sent by the principal. You can bring it to Wei Yong."
Seeing Chen Yang frowning, Yang Xuewei sighed: "Chen Yang, the principal has nothing to do. Facing those underworld bad guys, we ordinary people have nothing to do, otherwise we will cause greater disasters."
"The principal is not so bad. At least he prepared a red envelope for me."
Chen Yang laughed in his heart, grabbed the envelope on the table and stuffed it into his arms, and said to Yang Xuewei with a sad look on his face: "Teacher Yang, the world is really going downhill, bad guys are in power, and good people like us can only be bullied. Although my heart is burning with anger, for the sake of the overall situation, I decided to go find Wei Yong to ensure the safety of our Dong'an Polytechnic University students."
"Teacher Yang, where is the Black Wolf Gang's lair in Jianglin District? I'm going to find Wei Yong now." Chen Yang said solemnly.
Seeing Chen Yang's lamenting but righteous look, Yang Xuewei felt very uncomfortable. As a teacher, he should protect his students, but now, students are brave enough to do what is right, but they still have to apologize to others. This is really useless.
"Chen Yang, I'll go with you."
Yang Xuewei stood up from behind her desk, bit her bright red lips, her eyes were firm, and she looked like she was running to the battlefield.
Seeing this, Chen Yang became much less defensive about this charming woman. Although she was naturally very charming to men, she was kind-hearted, full of positive energy, and was a good teacher.
Chen Yang glanced at Yang Xuewei's body and wondered: "Teacher Yang, you are so beautiful, your figure isYou are so hot. Those are bad people. What if they do something to you? What will you do then? "
Seeing Chen Yang's gaze, Yang Xuewei blushed and tightened her collar quickly. However, she did not blame Chen Yang, but complained in her heart that she was too charming. Over the years, she knew exactly how attractive she was to men. Chen Yang had only just glanced at her body now, and he was already the most determined man she had ever seen.
Thinking that Chen Yang's words were indeed reasonable, and coupled with her super charm, Yang Xuewei was really afraid of being molested. You must know that those people dared to molest Lin Rou in school, and they would definitely be more unscrupulous in their territory.
However, Yang Xuewei only hesitated for a moment before making a decision and said firmly: "Chen Yang, you are my student, I must ensure your safety, and I must go with you. "
"Teacher Yang, since you insist on going, I will try my best to protect you even if I risk my life. "
Chen Yang relaxed his last guard against the charming Yang Xuewei, laughed secretly in his heart, and walked out of the office with Yang Xuewei.
